name: sheathing-nail

observes: stud positions along the sheet (mm), one read per stud
commands: 62-nail sheathing schedule of buildbot-fasten: nail targets at the stud-face centre line, tool tip placed to the commanded point

scene.sheet: 4x8 on end, studs 16 in o.c., 1.5 in stud face, 0.131 in nails, 3/8 in edge distance

note: A tolerance budget, not a controller: the reading scatter and tool-tip scatter a nailing robot must meet for 95% of sheets to have all 62 nails inside their windows (buildbot-studfind).
caveats: Simulated Gaussian error budget; not a rated accuracy.
No Unitree repeatability figure was found; the 0.9 mm tool scatter is buildbot-studfind's assumed robot term.
Nailing near people needs a risk assessment (ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066).
